common.securityNote: Your data and keys stay under your control.

setup.title: Create the Studio owner
setup.description: One local owner manages agents, versions, and runs. No external account is required.
setup.loginHint: At least 3 characters: lowercase Latin letters, numbers, dot, dash, or underscore.
setup.passwordHint: At least 12 characters. Only an Argon2id hash is stored.

validation.passwordShort: The password must contain at least 12 characters.

login.title: Welcome back
login.description: Sign in to your local Universal Agent Studio workspace.

agentImport.title: Import and activate an AgentSpec
agentImport.description: Choose a JSON AgentSpec. Studio validates it, stores an immutable version, and shows the exact digest before activation.
agentImport.security: Imports are schema-validated locally. Credentials are references, never embedded values.
agentImport.created: A new immutable version was created.
agentImport.reused: The identical immutable version already exists.

runner.title: Calculator agent
runner.description: Verify the complete agent path: typed input, planner model, safe tool, and structured result.
runner.inputHint: In this slice, the fake model reproducibly turns the control question into a calculator call.

readySteps.model: The model creates a typed operation.
readySteps.tool: The calculator performs an allowlisted computation.
readySteps.trace: Events and the redacted trace are stored locally.

run.title: Agent run
run.description: Events arrive from the local runtime, while the final trace is stored as reproducible execution evidence.
run.cancelError: Cancellation could not be requested. The event stream is still active; try again.

connection.error: The event stream could not be restored

result.pending: The result will appear when the run completes.
result.unavailable: The trace is not available yet. Refresh the page.

trace.title: How the agent completed the task
trace.description: The graph supports visual review, while the table mirrors it for keyboards and narrow screens.

inspector.selectNode: Select a node to inspect its trace.
inspector.notExecuted: This node has no stored execution yet.
inspector.redactionNote: Only values processed by the redaction policy are shown.

draft.eyebrow: Draft workspace · One spec, two editors
draft.bootstrapError: The draft could not be created. Make sure an active agent version exists, then try again.

settings.title: Agent basics
settings.description: The common product settings, mapped directly to AgentSpec.
settings.temperatureHint: 0 is deterministic; higher values add variation.
settings.noModel: This agent has no model profile.

graph.title: Execution graph
graph.description: Select or drag a node. Topology stays protected in this slice.

inspector.title: Node settings
inspector.empty: Select a node in the graph or its keyboard table.

bulk.title: Review complete AgentSpec JSON
bulk.description: Preview a deterministic diff first. Applying it uses the same validated save path.
bulk.invalidJson: The candidate is not valid JSON or did not pass validation.
bulk.stalePreview: The preview is stale or could not be applied. Build a new preview.
bulk.noChanges: The candidate matches the saved draft.

test.title: Test Console
test.description: Run the current saved revision without activating it.
test.error: Enter an input and save a valid revision before running.
test.empty: No draft test has been started in this session.

validation.summary: {count} validation issue(s) must be fixed before the draft can be saved.

errors.authentication_failed: Sign-in failed. Check the owner name and password.
errors.bootstrap_already_completed: The owner already exists. Go to sign in.
errors.durable_execution_unavailable: The run service is temporarily unavailable. Try again.
errors.agent_version_not_active: The active agent version is unavailable. Refresh the page.
errors.agent_version_digest_mismatch: The agent version changed. Refresh before running it.
errors.csrf_validation_failed: Your session is stale. Refresh and try again.
errors.rate_limit_exceeded: Too many attempts. Wait and try again.
errors.request_validation_failed: Check the fields and try again.
errors.run_input_invalid: The input does not match this agent interface.
errors.agent_spec_invalid: The AgentSpec is invalid. Review its schema and node references.
errors.active_version_changed: The active version changed. Refresh and try again.
errors.network_error: The local API is unreachable. Check that Studio is running.
errors.unknown: The action could not be completed. Try again.
